references.text: Moses anointed the tabernacle and the altar, which is the background for the dedication of the altar in which the leaders participated.
Moses anointed the tabernacle and the altar as part of the consecration ritual, preparing the altar for the offerings from the leaders.
The leaders who brought offerings at the dedication of the altar are the same ones who oversaw the census.
Summary of all the dedication gifts that the leaders brought forward at the dedication of the altar.
The leaders in Israel brought offerings at the dedication of the rebuilt temple, corresponding to the gifts of the leaders at the dedication of the altar.
Solomon and the leaders in Israel brought offerings at the dedication of the temple, in the same way as the leaders did at the dedication of the altar.
The Hanukkah festival (the temple dedication feast) takes its name from the Hebrew word חֲנֻכָּה (dedication), which is used here regarding the dedication of the altar.
